title: Go live
intro: One checklist from your running app to https on your domain. Each step shows what was found and the one thing to do next.
noDomain: No domain yet. The first steps work without one.
loadFailed: The checklist could not be loaded: {{message}}

scope.control_plane_host: Checked from this server. It cannot prove the wider internet can reach it. A Let's Encrypt certificate is that proof, because Let's Encrypt validated the domain from outside.

fix.title: Open ports 80 and 443?
fix.description: This changes the host firewall. Only these ports are opened, no other rule is touched, and a disabled firewall stays disabled.
fix.notPersistent: The rule is lost on reboot unless you save your firewall rules.

badge.link: Open the go live checklist for {{domain}}

cta.title: Your app is running: make it live on your domain
cta.body: Point a domain at it and get an automatic certificate, with live status at every step.
